-- Check st_mark values to understand what constitutes a finish
SELECT st_mark, COUNT(*) FROM constructor_results WHERE unitnode IN (SELECT cstr_key FROM constructors WHERE namelabel = 'McLaren') GROUP BY st_mark ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

-- Check all distinct st_mark values across the table
SELECT DISTINCT st_mark, COUNT(*) FROM constructor_results GROUP BY st_mark ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20;

-- Build cumulative CPS for McLaren
WITH mc_data AS (
    SELECT 
        r.yr,
        r.rak_id as race_id,
        c.namelabel as constructor_name,
        cr.scoreval,
        CASE WHEN cr.st_mark IS NULL OR cr.st_mark = 'None' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as finished,
        1 as started
    FROM constructor_results cr
    JOIN constructors c ON cr.unitnode = c.cstr_key
    JOIN races r ON cr.matchref = r.rak_id
    WHERE c.namelabel = 'McLaren'
),
mc_cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        yr,
        race_id,
        constructor_name,
        scoreval,
        SUM(finished) OVER (ORDER BY yr, race_id) as cum_finishes,
        SUM(started) OVER (ORDER BY yr, race_id) as cum_starts,
        SUM(scoreval) OVER (ORDER BY yr, race_id) as cum_points
    FROM mc_data
)
SELECT 
    yr,
    race_id,
    constructor_name,
    ROUND(CAST(cum_points * (CAST(cum_finishes AS numeric) / CAST(cum_starts AS numeric)) AS numeric), 2) as cumulative_cps
FROM mc_cumulative
ORDER BY yr, race_id
LIMIT 20;

    SELECT

        r.rak_id as race_id,

        1 as started
    FROM constructor_results cr
    JOIN constructors c ON cr.unitnode = c.cstr_key
    JOIN races r ON cr.matchref = r.rak_id
    WHERE c.namelabel = 'McLaren'
),
mc_cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        yr,
        race_id,
        constructor_name,
        scoreval,
        SUM(finished) OVER (ORDER BY yr, race_id) as cum_finishes,
        SUM(started) OVER (ORDER BY yr, race_id) as cum_starts,
        SUM(scoreval) OVER (ORDER BY yr, race_id) as cum_points,
        ROUND(CAST(SUM(scoreval) OVER (ORDER BY yr, race_id) * (CAST(SUM(finished) OVER (ORDER BY yr, race_id) AS numeric) / CAST(SUM(started) OVER (ORDER BY yr, race_id) AS numeric)) AS numeric), 2) as cumulative_cps
    FROM mc_data
)
SELECT 
    yr,

    constructor_name,
    cumulative_cps - COALESCE(LAG(cumulative_cps) OVER (ORDER BY yr, race_id), 0) as score_change
FROM mc_cumulative
ORDER BY yr, race_id;

-- Try computing CPS per year/season
WITH mc_data AS (
    SELECT 
        r.yr,
        r.rak_id as race_id,
        c.namelabel as constructor_name,
        cr.scoreval,
        CASE WHEN cr.st_mark IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as finished,
        1 as started
    FROM constructor_results cr
    JOIN constructors c ON cr.unitnode = c.cstr_key
    JOIN races r ON cr.matchref = r.rak_id
    WHERE c.namelabel = 'McLaren'
),
mc_cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        yr,
        race_id,
        constructor_name,
        scoreval,
        SUM(finished) OVER (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY race_id) as cum_finishes,
        SUM(started) OVER (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY race_id) as cum_starts,
        SUM(scoreval) OVER (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY race_id) as cum_points,
        ROUND(CAST(SUM(scoreval) OVER (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY race_id) * (CAST(SUM(finished) OVER (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY race_id) AS numeric) / CAST(SUM(started) OVER (PARTITION BY yr ORDER BY race_id) AS numeric)) AS numeric), 2) as cumulative_cps
    FROM mc_data
)
SELECT yr, race_id, constructor_name, cumulative_cps FROM mc_cumulative ORDER BY yr, race_id LIMIT 15;
